title: **__Illegal Missions__**
description:
**Description:**
*This script offers a dynamic system of illegal missions for your players, available solo or in teams. Missions are generated randomly, in a logical and coherent way, ensuring a varied experience without repetition. They refresh at regular intervals and are synchronized between players: if one team completes all available missions, others will have to wait for new ones to be generated. With the purchase, 5 DLCs are included, offering various missions such as: Gofast, Car Theft, Assassination, Armored Van Heist, and ATM Theft. And that's not all! You can easily add more illegal missions by installing additional DLCs.*

fields.name: 🛠️ **Features**
fields.value:
• **Automatic Generation of Illegal Missions – Missions are generated dynamically, ensuring variety and excitement.**
• **Team Play – Form a team with your friends and tackle missions together.**
• **Customizable Payment – The team leader can assign a percentage of the earnings to each member.**
• **Unique Missions – Every mission is designed to be engaging and never repetitive.**

fields.name: 🔗 **Dependencies**
fields.value: *Reputation System – Players gain or lose reputation based on their mission outcomes.*

fields.name: ⚙️ **How It Works**
fields.value:
• *Law Enforcement Alerts – Cops are notified based on the type of mission the player or team is undertaking.*
• *Advanced Player Stats – Track wins, losses, win/loss ratios, solo/team performance, and more.*
• *Easy DLC Integration – Add new missions effortlessly by simply dragging and dropping folders into your server.*
• *Perfect Synchronization – Seamless synchronization between players, ensuring everyone experiences missions at the same time without disruption.*

fields.name: 🔧 **Additional Configurations**
fields.value: _Multi-language Support – The script is available in 9 languages by default, with easy customization options._

fields.name: ❓ **Support**
fields.value: _Beautiful Web UI – User-friendly and visually appealing web interfaces._
